component.title: GeneratedForm
component.purpose: A schema-driven form whose field graph, layout, validation, recovery, and derived values remain one coherent experience.

states.description: A real settings model composes sections, conditional fields, arrays, objects, and a calculated output.
Submit-time validation preserves input, associates errors, and points directly to recovery.

claims.statement: Generated fields compose the shared form, field, section, action, summary, conditional, computed, array, and object contracts rather than duplicating them.
Validation preserves values, announces a summary, and leaves the failing field available for correction.
The same field graph remains legible at narrow widths as sections and compound fields reflow.
